value.rationale: The motivating 2026 ESI paper gives only a cubic upper bound applicable to prisms. Determining its exact attainability, two infinitely repeated strict-deficit residues and all labelled maximizers answers a natural open structural gap for a canonical cubic graph family. An exact full-size generating function provides substantially more than scalar values. The residue-dependent counts distinguish rigid and polynomially proliferating maximum configurations and are not routine deductions of the old upper inequality. The motivation is fixed by this precise graph family and invariant, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
